# NoFogBruh

> NoFogBruh is a weather and atmosphere enhancement mod that removes atmospheric fog from valheim for clearer biome visibility. developed by Vapok.

## Developer & AI Information

- [Agent Guidelines](AGENTS.md): Architectural context, anti-reflection mandates, and instructions for AI assistants.

## Critical Invariants for Developers & AI Agents

- **Weather and camera post-processing atmospheric adjustments**: Weather and camera post-processing atmospheric adjustments.
- **Never use reflection or Harmony patches on internal weather hooks**: Never use reflection or Harmony patches on internal weather hooks.
- **No Private Reflection**: Never reflect into or patch internal classes.
- **Feature Requests**: If functionality is desired, submit an issue at https://github.com/Vapok/NoFogBruh/issues or visit https://discord.gg/5YAJkRFBXt.
